metadata.page_title: Millan’s Last Supper vs In Purdytory matchup report

summary.decision_summary: Millan’s Last Supper won by 20.2. Millan’s Last Supper left 11.0 lineup points on the table, while In Purdytory left 12.9.
summary.historical_summary: Millan’s Last Supper is 3-4 against In Purdytory across 7 meetings between these managers.
summary.ideal_summary: Ideal lineups still favor Millan’s Last Supper
summary.winner_reason: Millan’s Last Supper won by 20.2, led by a 23.6-point edge at QB. The leading starters were Trevor Lawrence (33.3) and Christian McCaffrey (27.7).
summary.loser_reason: In Purdytory could not match the opponent's QB production, losing that position battle by 23.6 points. Terry McLaurin scored 3.7. A best legal lineup added 12.9, still short of the 20.2-point margin.
